about_the_game:
The Kingdom of Ethyria was once a beacon of prosperity, where gold flowed from the mountains, silver lined the rivers, and the people lived under the protection of their wise and powerful King. Yet beyond the glittering walls, shadows stir. Creatures born of hunger and desire wait for the chance to breach the kingdom’s borders, their eyes set on the palace and its people.

When the fragile peace begins to crack, the fate of Ethyria depends not only on the King’s strength but on those willing to stand beside him. Monsters descend in relentless waves, their power growing with every assault, and the question arises: can the royal line hold the walls alone, or will unexpected alliances and daring strategies be the kingdom’s salvation?

Royal Guards of Ethyria is a story-driven strategy game that merges visual novel-style choices with tactical defense. Step into a magical kingdom under siege, where every decision you make carries weight. As threats mount, you must search for the most capable knights, summon guardians to the palace gates, and command them against towering foes determined to shatter Ethyria’s peace.

Every battle tests your foresight and planning. Position your Royal Guards, manage limited resources, and adapt to an enemy that never attacks the same way twice. Between sieges, uncover the struggles and ambitions of those who fight for the kingdom, and decide which bonds of loyalty, rivalry, or intrigue will shape the battles to come.

Will you rise as the defender who shields Ethyria’s people from ruin, or falter as the kingdom crumbles under the weight of monsters unbound?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of sexual assault/non-consensual sex, drug/alcohol abuse, BDSM, and bestiality (monster-hybrids) which may be inappropriate for some players.
